fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Weixuan.

fullTextZH: 今天我们要讲一个故事
fullTextEN: Today we are going to tell a story.
The story is about a person.
We call her Da S.
Who is Da S?
She is a famous star.
From Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 她的中文名字是徐熙媛
fullTextEN: Her Chinese name is Xu Xiyuan.
But everyone likes to call her Da S.
Da S has many identities.
She is an actress.
A host and a fashion icon.
Da S was born in 1976.
Her family is very ordinary.

fullTextZH: 她有一个姐姐和一个妹妹
fullTextEN: She has an older sister and a younger sister.
Her younger sister is called Xiao S.
They have been close since childhood.
Da S loved performing as a child.

fullTextZH: 她梦想能成为一个明星
fullTextEN: She dreamed of becoming a star.

fullTextZH: 她和妹妹一起参加了舞蹈班
fullTextEN: She and her sister joined a dance class together.
Learn to dance

fullTextZH: 后来她们还一起参加了选秀比赛
fullTextEN: Later, they also participated in a talent show together

fullTextZH: 开始了她们的明星之路
fullTextEN: They began their path to stardom
Da S's career is very successful

fullTextZH: 她演过很多的电视剧和电影
fullTextEN: She has acted in many TV dramas and movies

fullTextZH: 最出名的电视剧是流星花园
fullTextEN: The most famous TV drama is Meteor Garden

fullTextZH: 她在里面演了一个叫杉菜的
fullTextEN: She played a character named Shan Cai in it
A cute girl

fullTextZH: 这部电视剧在亚洲非常火
fullTextEN: This TV drama was very popular in Asia

fullTextZH: 也就是说这部剧在亚洲非常有名
fullTextEN: That is to say, this drama was very famous in Asia

fullTextZH: 很多很多人喜欢这个电视剧
fullTextEN: Many, many people like this TV drama
They also like her very much
Besides acting
Da S is also a host

fullTextZH: 她和妹妹小s一起主持了一个节目
fullTextEN: She and her sister Xiao S hosted a show together
Called 100% Entertainment
This show is very interesting
Many people like to watch it

fullTextZH: 大s的爱情故事也很有趣
fullTextEN: Da S's love story is also very interesting
She once married Wang Xiaofei
Wang Xiaofei is an entrepreneur.

fullTextZH: 她们结婚后生了两个孩子
fullTextEN: They had two children after getting married.
A daughter and a son.
Da S loves her family very much.

fullTextZH: 她经常在社交媒体上分享她的生活
fullTextEN: She often shares her life on social media.
But in 2021,
Da S and Wang Xiaofei got divorced.

fullTextZH: 后来大s和她的家人住在台湾
fullTextEN: Later, Da S lived in Taiwan with her family.
Taking care of the children.
Continue her work.
Da S is not only a star,
but also a fashion icon.
She really likes beauty and skincare.
She has written many books.
Teaching everyone how to become beautiful.

fullTextZH: 很多人很喜欢她的风格
fullTextEN: Many people really like her style.
They think she is very charming.
Da S also cares about the environment.

fullTextZH: 她经常告诉大家要爱护环境
fullTextEN: She often tells everyone to protect the environment.
But I heard it yesterday.

fullTextZH: 一个让我非常震惊的消息
fullTextEN: A piece of news that shocked me greatly
February 2, 2025
When Da S was traveling in Japan
Because she caught the flu
It led to pneumonia and she passed away
She was only 48 years old when she passed away

fullTextZH: 她的妹妹小s在声明里说新年期间
fullTextEN: Her sister Xiao S said in a statement during the New Year
Our whole family came to Japan for a trip

fullTextZH: 我最亲爱的姐姐熙媛因为得了流感
fullTextEN: My dearest sister Xi Yuan caught the flu
The illness developed into pneumonia
Unfortunately, she left us

fullTextZH: 感恩这辈子能成为她的姐妹
fullTextEN: I am grateful to have been her sister in this life
Taking care of and accompanying each other
I will always be grateful to her
Miss her
Yes
A very sudden piece of news
Da S has passed away

fullTextZH: 我觉得大s是一个成功的明星
fullTextEN: I think Da S was a successful star
She had many roles
Actor, host, fashion icon
Her life is very exciting
But there are also many challenges
What about you, do you know Da S?

fullTextZH: 你们觉得她的故事有趣吗
fullTextEN: Do you think her story is interesting?

fullTextZH: 你还对哪位明星的故事感兴趣
fullTextEN: Which celebrity's story are you interested in?
Feel free to leave a comment and tell me
See you next time, bye-bye
